select count(1) from first_mile_weight_allocation wa
wa.cost_allocation_status = #{status} and wa.is_deleted = false

select wa.id, wa.source_id, wa.source_code sourceCode, wa.delivery_detail_id, wa.business_code businessCode, wa.transport_no transportNo, wa.product_name productName, wa.cost_allocation_status costAllocationStatus, wa.sku_id, wa.sku_no skuNo, wa.platform_sku_no platformSkuNo, wa.box_id, wa.box_no boxNo, wa.delivery_qty deliveryQty, wa.box_length, wa.box_width, wa.box_height, wa.box_size_unit, wa.out_stock_weight outStockWeight, wa.charged_weight chargedWeight, wa.volume_weight, wa.product_weight productWeight, wa.allocation_weight allocationWeight, wa.weight_unit, wa.supplier_id, wa.supplier_name supplierName, wa.allocation_type allocationType, wa.fee_rule feeRule, wa.shop_id, wa.shop_name shopName, wa.to_country toCountry, wa.to_country_name toCountryName, wa.from_warehouse_id fromWarehouseId, wa.calculate_period_id, wa.calculate_month, wa.logistics_bill_id, wa.create_time createTime from first_mile_weight_allocation wa
${params.sqlMap.default} and wa.is_deleted = false
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
wa.create_time DESC,wa.box_no

select wa.id, wa.source_id, wa.source_code sourceCode, wa.delivery_detail_id, wa.business_code businessCode, wa.transport_no transportNo, wa.product_name productName, wa.cost_allocation_status costAllocationStatus, wa.sku_id, wa.sku_no skuNo, wa.platform_sku_no platformSkuNo, wa.box_id, wa.box_no boxNo, wa.delivery_qty deliveryQty, wa.box_length, wa.box_width, wa.box_height, wa.box_size_unit, wa.out_stock_weight outStockWeight, wa.charged_weight chargedWeight, wa.volume_weight, wa.product_weight productWeight, wa.allocation_weight allocationWeight, wa.weight_unit, wa.supplier_id, wa.supplier_name supplierName, wa.allocation_type allocationType, wa.fee_rule feeRule, wa.shop_id, wa.shop_name shopName, wa.to_country toCountry, wa.to_country_name toCountryName, wa.from_warehouse_id fromWarehouseId, wa.calculate_period_id, wa.calculate_month, wa.logistics_bill_id, wa.create_time createTime from first_mile_weight_allocation wa
${params.sqlMap.default} and wa.is_deleted = false
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
wa.id DESC

select lb.id logisticsBillId, lb.outstock_id sourceId, lb.outstock_code sourceCode, lb.source_id businessId, lb.source_code businessCode, lb.transport_no transportNo, lb.logistics_supplier_id supplierId, lb.shop_id shopId, lb.shop_name shopName, lb.to_country toCountry, lb.channel_id channelId from logistics_bill lb left join logistics_bill_detail lbd on lb.id = lbd.main_id and lbd.is_deleted = false where lb.is_deleted = false and lb.id = #{logisticsBillId} and lbd.track_status in ('ordered', 'Inspecting', 'trackIng', 'arrived', 'sign', 'exception')

SELECT a.logistics_bill_id logisticsBillId, a.report_period_id reportPeriodId, a.account_period accountPeriod, a.status costAllocationStatus, ca.sku_id skuId, ca.sku_no skuNo, ca.bill_source_type billSourceType, cad.end_period_transit_cost as endPeriodTransitCost, rpm.month AS reportPeriod FROM first_mile_cost_allocation a LEFT JOIN first_mile_sku_cost_allocation ca ON ca.main_id = a.id AND ca.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN first_mile_sku_cost_allocation_detail cad ON cad.cost_main_id = ca.id AND cad.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN report_period_month rpm ON rpm.id = a.report_period_id AND rpm.is_deleted = FALSE where a.is_deleted = false and a.logistics_bill_id = #{logisticsBillId}
